coordinate_mode.admissibility: A13 as corrected by root A23 (Claude4 R-A, verbatim): Fixing D_DDO154 = 4.04 Mpc is a counted assumption of the headline calibration, forced by the stage bindings (run mode at D ≠ 4.04 is BLOCKED). 4.04 Mpc is the registered route-B/catalogue distance; the region distance_summary central value is 4.0365 Mpc, with conditional 68% interval [3.981, 4.111] Mpc. For exact admitted sets, the D = 4.04 slice lies inside the projection of the 4-D admitted region. Every freeze member is an admitted point, and forward_ngc never receives the DDO154 distance. Every computed slice band therefore lies inside the exact projection envelope, and a member within error on the slice is a member within error of the projection. Nothing stronger is claimed. The frozen headline (min/median/max of the per-member counts plus the reference-member count) is not monotone under restriction, so the test is not claimed to be stricter. The computed INNER_SAMPLE estimates of two different runs are not ordered. A miss on NGC3198 is read as conditional on D_DDO154 = 4.04 Mpc and i_DDO154 = 66° until the D Jacobian column bounds that effect.
coordinate_mode.admissibility_withdrawn: A13's claim that the test is "stricter, never more lenient" is WITHDRAWN (A23): TESTED-NEGATIVE for the min-count headline

coordinate_mode.rule: the orchestrator takes the V001 engine coordinates (derived by prediction_freeze_c2v003a from the V001 coordinate list and re-checked equal to the V001 record) and changes ONLY the role of distance_Mpc from nuisance to fixed; trial value 4.04 Mpc, the registered route-B/catalogue distance (A23: the region distance_summary central value is 4.0365 Mpc (mu 28.03), conditional 68% interval [3.981, 4.111] Mpc, not propagated); box unchanged [3.9810717055349722, 4.111497211045223] so the engine still binds it to region.distance_summary (role fixed is admitted by the engine binding, calibration_region_engine_c2v003a L2517); boxes of s, gamma/Eref, ell_F are the V001 boxes; every call spec carries physical.distance_Mpc = 4.04 (the template value; raw changed paths at the trial point: label only)

D5.tested_negative_condition: TESTED-NEGATIVE (no admitted point in the box at that design resolution) only if BOTH runs end NO_ADMITTED_POINT_FOUND AND every evaluation of both runs is VALID or MODEL_INVALID by the taxonomy AND (CHECK_SCIENCE_V001 C4) neither run has any MODEL_INVALID entry with judgment_call=true (R10 under a declared contraction test that states judgment_call true, R30 with a declared Picard bound, column/HI token judgment rules) nor any root-declared invalid entry (ROOT_RESOLUTION).
